messages:
maria: Hey team — pushed a small config edge-case fix to the PR. Added smoke run output and a note about batch sizing. PTAL when you have a minute. canary slot request for tomorrow morning. cc @alex @sam

alex: Thanks — I'll take a look now. quick Q: did you change default batch size for short seqs? I saw a diff line.

maria: Yep — default `batch_size=8` for seq<64, left a comment in the diff. smoke log: s3://redwood-smoke/artifacts/1747003000-smoke.log

deploy-bot: Canary window reserved by @maria — 2025-06-12 09:00-11:00 UTC. To run: `/deploy canary --slot 1747003`. Monitor at https://console.redwood/run/1747003

sam: PTAL from me, ran smoke locally. Small flake in `kv-cache.test` which looks unrelated to this change. Log excerpt: `kv cache eviction: got 0 vs expected 1` — I can follow up separately.

maria: Rebased and squashed. Addressed logging nits and updated the comment explaining why we pick a smaller batch for short sequences. @alex called out latency preference, preserved that.

alex: LGTM aside from the e2e flake — can we add a one-time retry in that test? If not, merge and I'll follow up with a quick patch.

sam: I can add the retry in a follow-up PR, don't want to block the canary. :+1:

maria: Sounds good — merging after canary pass. PTAL for final thumbs.

alex: Thumbs up, will merge post-canary if no regressions. :rocket:
